name: America's Least Wanted

tenures.source: A contemporaneous third-party recap of Day of Reckoning, 21 September 2003.

caption: Eliminated first, without landing a move, in a five-way gauntlet match for the vacant FSW Tag Team Championship on the federation's own debut supercard.

name: Youth Gone Wild

tenures.source: A contemporaneous third-party recap of Day of Reckoning, 21 September 2003.

caption: Won the vacant FSW Tag Team Championship in a gauntlet-turned-ladder match on the federation's own debut supercard; the second member is not named in this record's own holdings.

identity.note: An existing record of the same name is held as a single character (not a team) known only from the RSPWF Top 200 poll (best placing #27 in 1999, tagged UWF/EMWC in 1998-99, UWF in 2003 -- a different federation). The type mismatch and the differing federation tag both weigh against a join; recorded distinct per the museum's no-merge default.

name: Heaven't Hunted

tenures.source: A contemporaneous third-party recap of Day of Reckoning, 21 September 2003.

caption: Fell to Youth Gone Wild in a five-way gauntlet match for the vacant FSW Tag Team Championship on the federation's own debut supercard.

name: Fire and Ice

tenures.source: A contemporaneous third-party recap of Day of Reckoning, 21 September 2003.

caption: Interrupted Youth Gone Wild's Tag Team Championship celebration on the federation's own debut supercard; the second member ("Ice") is not named beyond that in this record's own holdings.

identity.note: Fire and Ice is a common tag-team name; two unrelated held federations already carry teams of this exact name. Nothing links any of the three beyond the shared name; recorded distinct per the museum's no-merge default.
